title: Why I Won't Spend Like a Millionaire

idea.name: Rural self-storage facilities
idea.one_liner: Self-storage facilities in rural US towns that rent units to local customers for monthly fees
idea.customer: Consumers and small users needing storage in rural US towns

key_quotes.quote: And I have business in rural towns all over America with my storage facility

claims.claim: General example: a business that could make $250K in one month is only about $125K after taxes. This is not specific to storage.
claims.quote: if you run a business that you could make 250K one month, which is by the way, it's only 125K after taxes

ideas.delivery: Physical storage facilities in rural US towns. The founder travels to them. Operating details not stated.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR applies to tenant data. Planning permission and business rates apply to storage sites. DMCC Act subscription rules may apply to rolling monthly rental contracts.

idea.name: Paid public speaking
idea.one_liner: Founder travels to give talks at events, paid by organisers through speaking fees or indirectly through business opportunities
idea.offer: Keynotes and talks given in person

key_quotes.quote: And I travel a lot to speak, to do business.

acquisition_channels.details: Not stated. It is implied to come from the guest's audience and personal brand.

ideas.delivery: The founder travels and speaks in person
